# M001-cb7uv2: Spectacle Windows Rebuild - Core Capture

**Status:** Draft - Discussion in progress

## Project Description

Rebuilding KDE Spectacle from the ground up for Windows. A desktop screenshot capture application with multiple capture modes, annotation tools, and export capabilities. Built for performance with minimal latency.

## M001 Vision

Build a high-performance screenshot capture application that can capture the entire desktop, individual monitors, active windows, windows under cursor, or rectangular regions. Users can preview screenshots, save them to configurable locations, copy to clipboard, and trigger captures via global shortcuts or command-line.

## Performance Requirements

- **Capture speed**: Near-instant from capture trigger to image availability
- **App startup**: Fast startup time, minimal initialization overhead
- **Framework efficiency**: Rust for performance-critical paths, WinUI 3 for UI

## Scope Decisions (Layer 1)

### In Scope for M001
- **Framework:** WinUI 3 (Microsoft's modern Windows UI framework)
- **Capture Engine** (all 5 modes):
  - Full Screen (all monitors)
  - Current Screen (monitor under cursor)
  - Rectangular Region (with on-screen selector UI)
  - Active Window
  - Window Under Cursor
- **UI Components:**
  - Preview window displaying captured screenshot
  - Rectangular region selector overlay
  - Delayed capture countdown indicator
- **Export:**
  - Save to file (with configurable location)
  - Copy to clipboard
- **Global Features:**
  - Global keyboard shortcuts (Print Screen variants)
  - Command-line interface for scripting
  - Multi-monitor support via Windows Graphics Capture API
- **Configuration:** Basic settings for save location and filename templates

### Out of Scope for M001
- Annotation editor (drawing tools, text, shapes, effects) — M002
- Advanced export (drag-and-drop, open in external apps) — M002
- Full configuration system (all settings from original Spectacle) — M002+

## Architectural Decisions (Layer 2)

### Core Architecture
- **Rust core + WinUI 3 shell**: Fast Rust capture engine using `windows-capture` crate, paired with WinUI 3 UI.

### Interop & Data Flow
- **C ABI + P/Invoke**: Rust compiles to C-compatible DLL, C# calls via P/Invoke.
- **Image data**: Direct to SoftwareBitmap for native WinUI 3 display.

### Capture Path Architecture
- **Hybrid**: MVVM for UI, direct imperative code for capture engine to minimize overhead.

### Global Hotkeys & CLI
- **Hotkeys**: Windows API RegisterHotKey from C#, C# orchestrates, Rust captures.
- **CLI**: C# command-line parser calls Rust core.

### Configuration Storage
- **JSON file in %APPDATA%**.

### Screen Capture API
- **Windows Graphics Capture API (WGC)** via `windows-capture` Rust crate.

## Error Handling Strategy (Layer 3)

### Capture Engine Failures
- **WGC API errors**: Return to C#, display user-friendly message, log technical details.
- **Monitor/window not found**: Graceful fallback, inform user.
- **Capture timeout**: Cancel, show error, allow retry.

### UI Layer Failures
- **Image display errors**: Show placeholder + error, keep image for save.
- **Clipboard copy failures**: Show error, offer save to file.
- **File save failures**: Handle permissions/disk full/invalid path, show specific error, offer alternatives.

### Interop Failures
- **Rust DLL not found**: Fatal error on startup, guide user.
- **P/Invoke call failures**: Log, show user message, graceful degradation.
- **Data conversion errors**: Log + show error, don't crash.

### Global Hotkeys
- **Registration fails**: Log, show warning, capture still works via UI/CLI.
- **Hotkey conflict**: Inform user, offer alternatives.

### CLI Failures
- **Invalid arguments**: Show usage + error, exit non-zero.
- **Capture fails**: Print error to stderr, exit non-zero, log details.

### Configuration Errors
- **Config corrupted**: Reset to defaults, inform user, backup corrupted file.
- **Invalid save path**: Show error, allow reconfigure, fall back to Pictures folder.

### User-Facing Error Behavior
- **Non-blocking errors**: Toast/status bar messages.
- **Blocking errors**: Modal dialogs for fatal errors.
- **Actionable errors**: Always include user action (retry, change setting, check permissions).

## Technical Stack
- **Capture Engine**: Rust + windows-capture
- **UI Framework**: WinUI 3 (C#)
- **Interop**: C ABI + P/Invoke
- **Configuration**: JSON file in AppData
- **Image Format**: SoftwareBitmap
- **Global Hotkeys**: Windows API RegisterHotKey
